name: Presentation Layer
description: The Swing GUI: the application entry point that bootstraps the JFrame plus the CardPanel screen router and the menu/play/settings/tutorial panels it navigates between.

name: Game Engine Layer
description: The engine package's session contracts and value objects (GameEngine, QuestionSource, Protocol, TurnResult, SessionResult) that will drive quiz-session logic between the GUI and the question data.

name: Data Layer
description: Question and Choice model classes plus the underlying question-bank data files (the legacy CSV draft and the current per-week MCQ JSON) that the engine layer loads sessions from.

name: Documentation & Project Configuration
description: Project-level markdown documentation (source-of-truth spec, team execution plan, VS Code README) plus the Understand-Anything tooling configuration file.
